info.title: Digger is a debugger for .NET (CoreCLR) applications.
info.description: Debug Adapter Protocol server for .NET (CoreCLR) applications.

options.description: build configuration (default Debug)

options.description: target framework of a multi-targeted project

options.name: --build-flags
options.description: extra arguments for dotnet build, e.g. --build-flags="-p:Foo=1"

options.name: --no-build
options.description: debug what was built last

commands.name: dap
commands.description: run a Debug Adapter Protocol server for an editor, over stdin/stdout

options.name: --server
options.description: listen on 127.0.0.1:port (default 4711) instead of stdin/stdout

options.name: --log
options.description:

options.name: --trace
options.description: also log every protocol message

digger test runs a Microsoft.Testing.Platform test project (xunit v3, MSTest, NUnit,
TUnit with the testing platform runner) as the program; arguments after -- go to it,
e.g. --filter-method (xunit v3) or --filter (MSTest).
